items.title: Saudi-Houthi escalation raises risk to Red Sea oil-export alternatives
items.summary: Reuters reports the Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port infrastructure after Houthi threats against Saudi Red Sea ports. The escalation threatens alternative export routes used amid Hormuz restrictions. Oil prices remain sensitive to both geopolitical risks and recovering supply; incremental Saudi export losses have not been verified.

observations.label: November 25 coalition statement
observations.value: Coalition reported strikes at Hodeidah after Houthi threats against Saudi Red Sea ports; damage and operational effects not independently established.

observations.label: Oil market context
observations.value: WSJ reports Brent $91.10 (-0.3%) and WTI $81.50 (-0.7%) in Wednesday trading; precise observation time not specified, not settlement.

observations.label: API estimate Nov 24
observations.value: Crude build 126,000 barrels versus 900,000 expected; secondary calendar source, pending EIA confirmation.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Saudi terminal operations, independent tanker loadings, insurance and freight, EIA 10:30 AM EST release and Nov 29 OPEC+ meeting. Stable exports would weaken disruption concern.

items.key_finding: Escalation threatens a critical alternative export corridor but does not establish incremental physical oil losses.

items.title: Hotter core inflation and upward GDP revision accompany accelerating technology selloff
items.summary: The BEA reported October core PCE inflation of 3.3% and revised third-quarter annualized GDP growth to 4.3%. The Nasdaq fell sharply in early cash trading. Strong growth and sticky inflation reinforce tightening expectations, adding valuation and financing risk to AI infrastructure without demonstrating equivalent weakness in the underlying economy.

observations.label: BEA 8:30 AM EST releases
observations.value: October headline PCE +3.8% YoY; core +3.3% YoY and +0.3% MoM; Q3 real GDP +4.3% annualized versus advance +3.4%.

observations.label: AP 9:50 AM EST market observation
observations.value: S&P 500 -3.0%, Nasdaq -4.3%, Dow -2.1% (1,033 points); NVDA -8.7%, AVGO -6.3%, MSFT -3.7%; intraday.

observations.label: Rates
observations.value: AP 10-year yield near 4.83%; WSJ reports reinforced expectations of December tightening.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Closing breadth, credit spreads, Treasury yields and December Fed expectations. Broad recovery and declining financing costs would weaken acute stress signal.

items.key_finding: Official macro releases add a monetary-policy headwind to existing AI valuation and financing concerns.

sources.title: BEA October personal income and outlays
WSJ Treasury yields and macro data

items.title: USTR publishes proposed Section 301 tariffs covering 14 economies
items.summary: USTR announced findings and proposed tariff measures covering fourteen economies, including major semiconductor-producing regions. Proposed rates vary by economy and include exemptions and existing-duty offsets. Public consultation and hearings remain ahead; the proposals are not effective duties. The announcement adds supply-chain cost uncertainty to technology and industrial markets.

observations.label: USTR November 25 official proposal
observations.value: China up to 20%, Taiwan and Korea up to 15%, EU 15%, India up to 25%; subject to applicable offsets, exemptions and negotiations.

observations.label: Status
observations.value: 14 determinations; Mexico and Norway not determined. Proposed duties not yet in effect.

observations.label: Market context
observations.value: AP reported Nasdaq -4.3% at 9:50 AM EST amid inflation, AI valuation and trade concerns; attribution to tariffs alone not established.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Product annexes, country of origin, negotiations, comment deadline Jan 5 2027 and hearings starting Jan 25 2027. Exemptions or negotiated reductions could mitigate exposure.

items.key_finding: Previously reported tariff risk has advanced to a formal proposal, increasing supply-chain uncertainty without imposing new duties today.

sources.title: Financial Express proposal and consultation report

items.title: Ambarella warns memory scarcity is cutting customer outlooks
items.summary: Ambarella reported record edge AI revenue but warned that memory scarcity and prices are causing customers to reduce forecasts. Next-quarter revenue guidance suggests a substantial sequential decline. The premarket selloff reflects a documented operating headwind rather than sentiment alone.

observations.label: Nov 25 6:46 AM EST premarket
observations.value: AMBA -35.55%; not a closing price.

observations.label: Nov 24 fiscal Q3 report
observations.value: Revenue $115.2M, +6.2% YoY; GAAP gross margin 57.8%; GAAP net loss $12.7M.

observations.label: Next quarter guidance
observations.value: $70–75M revenue; midpoint approximately 37% below Q3.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Memory prices, supply availability, customer forecasts and order recovery.

items.key_finding: Memory shortages are now causing documented demand pressure downstream in edge AI.

items.title: Dell sells off despite record quarterly results and raised guidance
items.summary: Dell more than doubled quarterly revenue and significantly raised its annual outlook. Shares traded lower before the open despite the strong results. Backlog conversion, financing and memory costs remain important risks.

observations.label: Nov 25 7:45 AM EST premarket
observations.value: DELL $281.68, -4.6%; not closing data.

observations.label: Q3 FY27
observations.value: Revenue $54.9B, +103% YoY; adjusted EPS $9.45; operating cash flow $4.5B.

observations.label: AI backlog and guidance
observations.value: Approximately $132B AI backlog; FY27 revenue guide $202B.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Order conversion, customer financing, cancellations, margins and cash generation.

items.key_finding: Strong reported hardware fundamentals diverge from negative market sentiment; valuation and execution risks remain.
